novel_features.name: Duplicate payee audit
novel_features.description: Find payee spelling variants (AMZN Mktp vs Amazon Marketplace) and get a ready-to-run payees merge plan (merging runs through the sidecar).
novel_features.rationale: Clusters payees across the payee mapping and transaction history in the locally mirrored budget — no API exposes duplicate detection.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Reach for this after an import when payee lists look messy; it returns merge pairs an agent can apply via payees merge.

novel_features.name: Duplicate transaction finder
novel_features.description: Catch transactions that were imported or entered twice, ranked by confidence.
novel_features.rationale: Fuzzy self-join over the whole mirrored ledger excluding deleted rows and split children.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use after overlapping CSV imports to find double-counted spending before it skews reports.

novel_features.name: Categorize from history
novel_features.description: Get a category suggestion for every uncategorized transaction based on how you categorized that payee before; categorize apply writes them through the actual-http-api sidecar.
novel_features.rationale: Needs each payee's full categorization history from the local mirror; applies through the REST sidecar.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Pick this to clear the uncategorized queue in bulk instead of one PATCH per transaction.

novel_features.name: Dead rule audit
novel_features.description: Find rules that never match, are shadowed by another rule, or point at deleted payees and categories.
novel_features.rationale: Evaluates every rule condition against the entire mirrored ledger locally.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use when the rules list has grown large and imports categorize unpredictably.

novel_features.name: Local SQL passthrough
novel_features.description: Run read-only SQL against your real budget database without Node or a running engine.
novel_features.rationale: The downloaded budget is a SQLite file; the CLI opens it read-only.
novel_features.example: actual-budget-pp-cli ledger sql "SELECT name, offbudget FROM accounts WHERE tombstone = 0" --agent
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for any ad-hoc question the canned reports do not answer.

novel_features.name: Stale schedule audit
novel_features.description: List bills that are overdue with nothing posted and schedules whose amounts drifted.
novel_features.rationale: Joins schedules to the transactions they posted in the local mirror.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use in a weekly bills check to spot missed or changed recurring payments.

novel_features.name: Goal-template status
novel_features.description: See which envelopes are under- or over-funded against the #template and #goal targets in category notes.
novel_features.rationale: Parses Actual's note-based template syntax and joins it to the month's budgeted amounts.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use at the start of a month before funding envelopes.

novel_features.name: Change log since
novel_features.description: See what was edited, deleted, or restored in the budget since a point in time, with names resolved.
novel_features.rationale: Decodes Actual's CRDT sync message log stored inside the budget file.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use for a household check-in on what a partner changed, or to audit an import.

narrative.headline: Your Actual Budget ledger in one static binary: search, SQL, reports and cleanup audits on a local copy pulled straight from your own Actual server, no Node required.
narrative.value_prop: mirror pull downloads your budget from your actual-server into a local read-only mirror, so ledger, report, audit, templates and changes run offline without the Node API or a version-matched sidecar. Cleanup audits (audit payees, ledger duplicates, audit rules, categorize suggest) surface work the app does not list for you, and the full actual-http-api surface (accounts, payees, transactions, months, ...) plus import-csv is available when you run that sidecar.
narrative.auth_narrative: Reads (required): set ACTUAL_SERVER_URL (e.g. http://localhost:5006), ACTUAL_PASSWORD (or ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN), and ACTUAL_SYNC_ID (Settings → Show advanced settings → Sync ID, or run budgets-remote), plus ACTUAL_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD if end-to-end encryption is on. Each also accepts a _FILE variant pointing at a secret file. Then run mirror pull. Writes and generated endpoint commands (optional): run the actual-http-api sidecar (https://github.com/jhonderson/actual-http-api) and set ACTUAL_BUDGET_BASE_URL (default http://localhost:5007/v1) and ACTUAL_HTTP_API_KEY to the API_KEY you configured on it.

quickstart.comment: Confirm the binary runs (no network); run plain doctor after exporting credentials
After exporting ACTUAL_SERVER_URL and ACTUAL_PASSWORD: list budgets and their sync ids
With ACTUAL_SYNC_ID set: download the budget into the local mirror
See where the money went this month
Find transactions still needing a category

troubleshoots.fix: export ACTUAL_SYNC_ID to a sync id from budgets-remote, or pass --budget-sync-id

troubleshoots.symptom: exit 4: unauthorized or invalid-password from the Actual server
troubleshoots.fix: Check ACTUAL_PASSWORD (or ACTUAL_SESSION_TOKEN), then rerun mirror pull
Set ACTUAL_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD to the budget encryption password

troubleshoots.symptom: offline commands return [] with a no local mirror hint
generated commands (accounts list, payees merge, ...) fail with connection refused
troubleshoots.fix: Start the actual-http-api sidecar and set ACTUAL_BUDGET_BASE_URL and ACTUAL_HTTP_API_KEY

troubleshoots.symptom: sidecar errors like no such column after an Actual upgrade
troubleshoots.fix: Run doctor to compare sidecar and server versions; upgrade the sidecar image to match

narrative.when_to_use: Use this CLI to answer questions about an Actual Budget ledger (spending, balances, uncategorized or duplicate transactions, rule and schedule health, template funding, recent changes) from the terminal or an agent; these read a local mirror pulled with mirror pull. With the actual-http-api sidecar running it also scripts writes: bank CSV imports (import-csv), bulk categorization (categorize apply), payee merges and the full accounts, transactions and budget-month API.
anti_triggers: Do not use it to edit budgets in real time alongside an open web UI session expecting instant reflection; offline commands read a snapshot until mirror pull runs again
Do not use it for bank connection setup (GoCardless/SimpleFIN linking); do that in the Actual web app
Do not use it for YNAB; use a YNAB tool
